metadata.scenario: A customer is questioning a duplicate charge on their credit card statement. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret Thompson speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Patricia Wilson. I'm calling about a duplicate charge I noticed on my credit card statement. I’m sorry to hear that, Patricia. Let me help you sort that out. Can you provide me with the charge details? Yes, it was a charge for post-surgery recovery care for my mother, and it appears twice for the same date. I understand. Can you please tell me the date of the service you’re referring to? It was on March 5th. Both charges are for $95. Thank you for that information. Let me check our records for March 5th and see what I can find. Okay, I appreciate it. I'm worried about this charge since it’s not something I expected. I understand your concern, Patricia. I’ll do my best to clarify this for you. Just a moment while I pull up the details... Alright, I see one charge for the post-surgery recovery care, but it seems there was a mistake in processing that day. So, there was a duplicate entry? Yes, it looks like one of our staff mistakenly entered the service twice in the system. That’s frustrating. What can be done about it? I can initiate a refund for the duplicate charge right away, and you should see it credited back to your account in 3 to 5 business days. Thank you for that. I appreciate your quick response. Of course! Also, would you like to schedule any additional services for your mother? Actually, yes. I’d like to arrange for ongoing post-surgery care. Great! We can arrange that for you. I can connect you with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen. That sounds good, thank you. I’ll have Lisa reach out to you. May I have your best contact number to pass along? Sure, it’s +13165558471. Thank you, Patricia. I’ll ensure Lisa gets in touch with you soon to discuss the care plan. Thank you again for your help, Margaret. You’re welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that’s everything for now. Alright, have a great day, Patricia! Thanks, you too!
